sources.title: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
Quality and Methodology Information for BDUK Delivery Performance 2025/26
Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual April 2025 to March 2026
January 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
February 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
March 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
April 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
Mobile connectivity you can count on

candidates.name: January-to-April built-premises increase
candidates.gate: Monthly management snapshots; ingestion and scope revisions prevent delivery-performance scoring.

candidates.name: January-to-April contracted-premises change
candidates.gate: Initial-scope totals can change administratively.

candidates.name: January-to-February built change
candidates.gate: Snapshot change, not audited monthly delivery.

candidates.name: February-to-March built change
candidates.gate: Snapshot change, not audited monthly delivery.

candidates.name: March-to-April built change
candidates.gate: Snapshot change, not audited monthly delivery.

candidates.name: April built-to-contracted ratio
candidates.gate: Rounded management data and changing initial scope.

candidates.name: January built-to-contracted ratio
candidates.gate: Rounded management data and changing initial scope.

candidates.name: Management-versus-official-statistics separation
candidates.gate: Never combine contracted/built snapshots with subsidy-attributable delivery without reconciliation.

candidates.name: Deferred-scope omission
candidates.value: not included in monthly contracted totals
candidates.gate: Absence from initial scope is not absence from future delivery.

candidates.name: Management-data ingestion lag
candidates.gate: Do not assess contractual milestones from monthly snapshots.

candidates.name: Management-data rounding
candidates.gate: Derived differences require rounding tolerance.

candidates.name: April CO8 Cheshire observation
candidates.gate: New contract/snapshot value; no milestone inference.

candidates.name: Central Cornwall April initial-scope ratio
candidates.gate: Initial scope only; does not establish every local parcel is served.

candidates.name: Ofcom gigabit availability
candidates.gate: National January 2026 aggregate; exact UPRN join required.

candidates.name: Ofcom gigabit six-month change
candidates.gate: National trend, not parcel evidence.

candidates.name: Fixed/FWA decent-broadband residual
candidates.gate: National residual; satellite and affordability rules handled separately.

candidates.name: Affordable decent-broadband residual
candidates.gate: Eligibility depends on price and technical USO conditions.

candidates.name: Commercial-premises USO exclusion
candidates.gate: Some may already have leased-line connectivity.

candidates.name: UPRN epoch/new-build gap
candidates.value: absent UPRNs can be new builds or filtered records
candidates.gate: Absence must not be classified as no service.

candidates.name: BDUK local-authority file count
candidates.gate: Require complete manifest and content hashes before ingestion.

candidates.name: Intervention overlap rate
candidates.gate: Deduplicate by exact UPRN and intervention state.

candidates.name: GIS demolished-premises discrepancy
candidates.gate: Verify current OS classification and contract status.

candidates.name: Voucher UPRN method attrition
candidates.gate: Methodological adjustment, not an observed parcel failure rate.

candidates.name: Voucher multiplier attrition
candidates.gate: Used only when expected-premises data are unavailable or poor quality.

candidates.name: Voucher multiplier-estimated share
candidates.gate: Distinguish estimated from directly validated premises.

candidates.name: Annual BDUK delivery
candidates.gate: Annual subsidy-attributable delivery; not current availability at every listed parcel.

candidates.name: GIS annual delivery share
candidates.gate: Programme aggregate.

candidates.name: Rural annual delivery share
candidates.gate: Rural aggregate; no individual parcel promotion.

candidates.name: SRN 2027 UK landmass target
candidates.gate: Future obligation is not current coverage.

candidates.name: Exact UPRN promotion requirement
candidates.value: current source package + hashes + exact UPRN join
candidates.gate: Canonical parcel promotion remains blocked until runtime recovery.
